codeSnippets.description: Secure serverless API route example for commission enquiries (TypeScript).
codeSnippets.snippet: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'; export async function POST(request: Request) { try { const body = await request.json(); const { name, email, message, projectType } = body; if (!name || !email || !message) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing required fields' }, { status: 400 }); } console.log('Commission enquiry', { name, email, projectType }); return NextResponse.json({ status: 'ok' }); } catch (err) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid request' }, { status: 400 }); } }
